notes: Seattle has a city file (Secure Scheduling, $21.30 minimum wage).
No state daily overtime listed in the DOL table.
Drafted from US DOL WHD state tables (confidence=medium) on 2026-11-06; upgrade to primary sources pending.
minimum_wage.effective is the DOL table date (2026-11-05), not the statutory effective date.

Minors (WAC 296-125-101, eff. 2026-07-01): the school-day cap applies to school days preceding another school day, so Friday is 8 h; the validator treats Friday as a school day (stricter). Minors working past 8 p.m. in service jobs need an adult supervisor on site. Extra param key max_days_week.
Minors: separate meal/rest-break rules for minors (WAC 296-125-111, -121) and prohibited jobs (WAC 296-125-131, -141) not yet encoded; federal HO 7 applies.

rules.summary: Washington requires a 30-minute meal period for work over 5 hours.

rules.summary: Washington requires a paid 10-minute rest period per 4 hours worked.

rules.summary: During school weeks, minors under 16 may work at most 3 hours on a school day before another school day (8 otherwise), 16 hours and 6 days a week, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. before a school day (9 p.m. Fridays/Saturdays).

citation.title: WAC 296-125-101 — Hours of work for minors (eff. July 1, 2026)
citation.excerpt: A maximum of three hours per day on any school day preceding another school day or otherwise a maximum of eight hours per day; (ii) A maximum of six days per week; (iii) A maximum of 16 hours per week

rules.summary: During non-school weeks, minors under 16 may work at most 8 hours a day, 40 hours and 6 days a week, 7 a.m.-9 p.m.

citation.title: WAC 296-125-101 — Hours of work for minors (eff. July 1, 2026)
citation.excerpt: during nonschool weeks: (i) A maximum of eight hours per day; (ii) A maximum of six days per week; (iii) A maximum of 40 hours per week; (iv) No earlier than 7:00 a.m.; and (v) No later than 9:00 p.m.

rules.summary: During school weeks, 16- and 17-year-olds may work at most 4 hours on a school day before another school day (8 otherwise), 20 hours and 6 days a week, 7 a.m.-10 p.m. before a school day (midnight Fridays/Saturdays).

citation.title: WAC 296-125-101 — Hours of work for minors (eff. July 1, 2026)
citation.excerpt: A maximum of four hours per day on any school day preceding another school day ... (iii) A maximum of 20 hours per week ... (v) No later than 10:00 p.m. on any day preceding a school day

rules.summary: During non-school weeks, 16- and 17-year-olds may work at most 8 hours a day, 48 hours and 6 days a week, 5 a.m.-midnight.

citation.title: WAC 296-125-101 — Hours of work for minors (eff. July 1, 2026)
citation.excerpt: during nonschool weeks: (i) Maximum of eight hours per day; (ii) Maximum of six days per week; (iii) Maximum of 48 hours per week; (iv) No earlier than 5:00 a.m.; and (v) No later than 12:00 a.m.
